hardware: AMD Radeon Pro W7900 (gfx1100), GPU0; host shared with a concurrent GPU1 job during the pre-port baseline only
purpose: UD route-plan item F: port the dense-IQ W4A16 prefill policy and the item-2 Q5 T16 dense role coverage to gfx1100, then measure the UD vs plain Q4_K_M/S comparison on the W7900 under the published protocol.

hipengine/kernels/hip_gfx1100/__init__.p: GGUF_IQ_DENSE_PREFILL_POLICY added (4-quant W4A16 set, mirrors the gfx1151 default)
GGUF_DENSE_Q5_T16_H5120 = True (item-2 Q5 dense role coverage port)

before_port_ud_km.note: contended run (concurrent GPU1 job); clean census showed prefill 137.6 / decode 15.52 pre-Q5T16, so the Q5T16 deltas below use the clean pre-state 137.6/15.52

route_ab_8layers.note: W4A16 policy A/B at max-layers=8; the dense-IQ route engages on gfx1100

top_owners_gpu_time: gguf_iq_dense_strict_kernel<3> (Q3_K prefill, unrouted by the mean gate)
prefill_census_after_port.note: rocprofv3 kernel trace /tmp/ud-census2; materialization plan now identical between hip_gfx1100 and hip_gfx1151 (61.3% optimized bytes on K_M)

limitations: Gross rates from a desktop host; no power/thermal caveat needed (unlike the zbook laptop numbers).
Plain arms were measured while the host was contended by a concurrent GPU1 job; the plain arm was verified contention-insensitive (868.7 clean vs 856.2 contended prefill, 26.58 vs 28.57 decode).
The pre-port UD baseline was contended; use the clean census numbers (137.6/15.52) for pre/post deltas.
